display: Sharm El Sheikh + Red Sea Riviera
tagline: A world dive capital with both shores of the Red Sea in reach.
summary: Sharm anchors Egypt's Red Sea Riviera — Ras Mohammed, Nabq, Dahab on the Sinai side, and the Hurghada / Sahl Hasheesh / Makadi coast across the gulf. Pioneer II handles the close-in resort and dive hops; Quanta-LR's hybrid range turns the cross-gulf coast and the line toward Aqaba into single smooth legs.
